upstreams.description: List of backend server clusters for load balancing.

name.description: Unique name of the load balancer cluster (used in URLs and internal references).

host.description: IP address or hostname of a backend server.

port.description: Port the backend service listens on.

enabled.description: If false, marks this backend as temporarily unavailable (but still listed).

weight.description: Relative weight for weighted load balancing (higher = more traffic).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections to this backend (0 = unlimited).

timeout.description: Connection/transfer timeout for this backend in seconds (0 = inherit global).

sticky_session.description: Enable session stickiness using ROUTEID cookie (requires backend to set session cookie).

alias.description: URL path prefix to proxy to this cluster (e.g., 'api' → proxies /api/*). If empty, proxies all paths.
